1_new_important_findings: Current KEIRIN.JP states that competition rules/judging are common across velodromes. Venue difference must not be assumed to be rule difference.
Current JKA judging body verifies duty-to-compete / 敢闘義務-related conduct, lap-miscount disqualification criteria, section-specific exemptions, and race-non-establishment states.

Line cooperation, leader/self-powered and follower/bante roles are officially described as real keirin mechanisms, but a timing-safe objective per-race line-membership source is not verified. Human narabi information must not be promoted to objective truth.
Current official racecard concepts are substantially richer than S0: H, B, S, style, historical 逃/捲/差/マ, class, age and recent-result notation are officially documented.
Current JKA race operations formally measure wind direction, wind speed and temperature. Reality existence is supported; public pre-start availability/timing remains unresolved.

Current official bank source paths exist: national circumference coverage is strong, and current organizer sources can provide detailed geometry such as estimated straight, slopes and widths. A nationally versioned historical registry is not yet complete.
Registered bicycle and certified-part detail bodies were retrieved and verified; equipment is a formal reality, but rider/race-specific historical equipment state remains unresolved.

2_already_represented_in_current_model.note: Untouched S0 sporting utility uses only competition_score; public score is officially described as recent-four-month strength information, while exact regulatory calculation/update mapping remains unresolved.
Race membership/denominator mechanically enters softmax/PL, but no explicit entrant lifecycle, field-size regime term or scratch redistribution state machine exists.
Sequential PL is transparent engineering, not an official claim about how real placements are generated.

Gear/bicycle state with historical completeness/change timestamps

scientific_direction_after_audit: Do not respond to newly discovered official fields by bulk feature addition. First preserve S0, use Reality KB to improve population/selection/state contracts, then run one separately prespecified low-DOF experiment at a time with untouched future evaluation.
